title: migrate-openssl-and-modernize-jwt-saml-stack
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: Replace legacy crypto and identity stacks that are the source of recurring security findings and fragile runtime behavior. This ticket covers: upgrading OpenSSL across our runtimes to 3.2 (with an opt-in FIPS build path), replacing ad-hoc JWT helpers with a single vetted JOSE library surface, and hardening the SAML parsing pipeline to remove fragile XML parsing paths. Scope includes build/tooling changes, runtime compatibility shims, CI gating, canary rollout for Dedicated and Hosted, automated test coverage, and a rollback plan. Non-goals: application-level auth flows or SSO UX changes (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: All runtime binaries build with OpenSSL 3.2 on linux-x86_64 and linux-arm64 CI images without regressions
Critical services (inference runtime, control-plane auth, console backend) pass end-to-end auth smoke tests using new JOSE-based token verifier
SAML assertion processing rejects known malformed XML vectors and adds structure-level validation hooks; fuzzing run with zero regressions in parsing pipeline
Feature-flagged canary (10% traffic) for host- and dedicated- customers active, no increase in auth-related 5xx or latency > 200ms per-token at p99
Automated dependency SBOM and license checks updated; all transitive CVEs resolved or mitigated with documented exceptions
Security review completed and sign-off attached in Confluence
Rollback path: previous OpenSSL 1.1/3.0 build artifacts and JWT adapters available and automated failover tests pass
tasks: Create OpenSSL 3.2 container images and add FIPS build matrix to CI
Introduce a small compatibility adapter layer (auth-adapter-v2) that routes to new JOSE verifier while retaining old path behind flag
Replace xmlsec usages in saml-processor with a hardened native parser and canonicalization step
Pin transitive cryptographic dependencies in monorepo and add weekly Snyk/GH-Actions audit job
Add integration tests: token issuance/verification, long-signed JWTs with key rotation, SAML end-to-end flows
Create canary rollout plan and automation (traffic-slice + health-check dashboard)
Update operator documentation and migration runbook for Dedicated/Private customers
Coordinate with infra for OS-level entropy/time sync tests on arm64 nodes
